fields.name: PgConnectionConfiguration connection resolution
fields.contract: PgConnectionConfiguration exposes a PostgreSQL IDataConnection implementation. SetAmbientConfiguration accepts global, shard-set, read/write, and shard property sources; only PgConnectionPropertiesBase inputs participate; it stops observing any previously supplied sources, subscribes to each new source's PropertyChanged, and clears any cached connection string and description. GetConnectionString builds (and caches) one connection string by applying each level in order global, shard set, read/write, shard, then local, where a level's property is applied whenever it is not null (an `is null` test) — so a later level's empty string DOES override an earlier value. When it builds the string it also sets the cached ConnectionDescription to "database {Database} on server {Host}" from the built values. ConnectionDescription, when no description is cached, resolves Database and Host across the same order using a not-null-and-not-empty test (string.IsNullOrEmpty) — so a later level's empty string does NOT override an earlier non-empty value — caches "database {Database} on server {Host}", and returns it; the two rules therefore differ only when some level supplies an empty Database or Host. A PropertyChanged on the configuration's own (local) properties or on any currently supplied inherited (ambient) level clears both the cached connection string and the cached description, so the next read re-resolves.
